stanzas.sanskrit:
प्राचेतसस्तु भगवन्नपरोऽपि दक्ष-
-स्त्वत्सेवनं व्यधित सर्गविवृद्धिकामः ।
आविर्बभूविथ तदा लसदष्टबाहु-
-स्तस्मै वरं ददिथ तां च वधूमसिक्नीम् ॥ २३-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Another Daksha apart from Prachetas son was deeply devoted to Lord and pleased with his devotion, Lord appeared before him and granted him Asikini as his bride and fulfilled his wish to create mankind.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
prācetasastu bhagavannaparo’pi dakṣa-
-stvatsevanaṃ vyadhita sargavivṛddhikāmaḥ |
āvirbabhūvitha tadā lasadaṣṭabāhu-
-stasmai varaṃ daditha tāṃ ca vadhūmasiknīm || 23-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तस्यात्मजास्त्वयुतमीश पुनःसहस्रं
श्रीनारदस्य वचसा तव मार्गमापुः ।
नैकत्रवासमृषये स मुमोच शापं
भक्तोत्तमस्त्वृषिरनुग्रहमेव मेने ॥ २३-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Eleven thousand sons born to him took to path of salvation with Sage Narada's advice instead of continuing with the job of creation. Angry with Sage Narada, Daksha cursed him that he will never have a permanent place to stay, which Sage treated as a blessing.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tasyātmajāstvayutamīśa punaḥsahasraṃ
śrīnāradasya vacasā tava mārgamāpuḥ |
naikatravāsamṛṣaye sa mumoca śāpaṃ
bhaktottamastvṛṣiranugrahameva mene || 23-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
षष्ट्या ततो दुहितृभिः सृजतः कुलौघान्
दौहित्रसूनुरथ तस्य स विश्वरूपः ।
त्वत् स्तोत्रवर्मितमजापयदिन्द्रमाजौ
देव त्वदीयमहिमा खलु सर्वजैत्रः ॥ २३-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Daksha then multiplied mankind through his sixty daughters, Vishwaroopa one of his daughter's son helped Indra win Battle over asuras, by teaching him Narayana kavacha, prayer addressed to Lord seeking protection.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ṣaṣṭyā tato duhitṛbhiḥ sṛjataḥ kulaughān
dauhitrasūnuratha tasya sa viśvarūpaḥ |
tvat stotravarmitamajāpayadindramājau
deva tvadīyamahimā khalu sarvajaitraḥ || 23-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्राक् शूरसेनविषये किल चित्रकेतुः
पुत्राग्रही नृपतिरङ्गिरसः प्रभावात् ।
लब्ध्वैकपुत्रमथ तत्र हते सपत्नी-
-सङ्घैरमुह्यदवशस्तव माययाऽसौ ॥ २३-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Chitraketu, King of Surasena, got a son with the blessing of Sage Angirasa through his first wife which was killed by one of his other wives by jelousy. Grief struck, King lost self-control, dwelling in maya and agony.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
prāk śūrasenaviṣaye kila citraketuḥ
putrāgrahī nṛpatiraṅgirasaḥ prabhāvāt |
labdhvaikaputramatha tatra hate sapatnī-
-saṅghairamuhyadavaśastava māyayā’sau || 23-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तं नारदस्तु सममङ्गिरसा दयालुः
सम्प्राप्य तावदुपदर्श्य सुतस्य जीवम् ।
कस्यास्मि पुत्र इति तस्य गिरा विमोहं
त्यक्त्वा त्वदर्चनविधौ नृपतिं न्ययुङ्क्त ॥ २३-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Sage Narada and Angirasa took the soul of his lost son to the king, which asked him ''whose son am I? . In which birth of mine, were you my father? Due to karma, I attained different parents in different Janmas". The questions asked by soul removed delusion in Chitraketu's mind.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
taṃ nāradastu samamaṅgirasā dayāluḥ
samprāpya tāvadupadarśya sutasya jīvam |
kasyāsmi putra iti tasya girā vimohaṃ
tyaktvā tvadarcanavidhau nṛpatiṃ nyayuṅkta || 23-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्तोत्रं च मन्त्रमपि नारदतोऽथ लब्ध्वा
तोषाय शेषवपुषो ननु ते तपस्यन् ।
विद्याधराधिपतितां स हि सप्तरात्रे
लब्ध्वाप्यकुण्ठमतिरन्वभजद्भवन्तम् ॥ २३-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Then receiving hymns and Mantras from Sage Narada, Chitraketu worshipped Bhagwan who were in the form of Aadishesha and got the leadership of Vidyadharas in 7 days and continued to worship Bhagwan with the same devotion.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
stotraṃ ca mantramapi nāradato’tha labdhvā
toṣāya śeṣavapuṣo nanu te tapasyan |
vidyādharādhipatitāṃ sa hi saptarātre
labdhvāpyakuṇṭhamatiranvabhajadbhavantam || 23-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तस्मै मृणालधवलेन सहस्रशीर्ष्णा
रूपेण बद्धनुतिसिद्धगणावृतेन ।
प्रादुर्भवन्नचिरतो नुतिभिः प्रसन्नो
दत्त्वाऽऽत्मतत्त्वमनुगृह्य तिरोदधाथ ॥ २३-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Lord Vishnu revealed to him in the form of Aadishesha, with a thousand hoods and white like a lotus stalk,surrounded by bands of Sidhdhaas singing hymns of praise.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tasmai mṛṇāladhavalena sahasraśīrṣṇā
rūpeṇa baddhanutisiddhagaṇāvṛtena |
prādurbhavannacirato nutibhiḥ prasanno
dattvā”tmatattvamanugṛhya tirodadhātha || 23-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वद्भक्तमौलिरथ सोऽपि च लक्षलक्षं
वर्षाणि हर्षुलमना भुवनेषु कामम् ।
सङ्गापयन् गुणगणं तव सुन्दरीभिः
सङ्गातिरेकरहितो ललितं चचार ॥ २३-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Chitraketu wandered happily in all the worlds singing in praise of Lord without much attachment and praised Bhagwan to his hearts content.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvadbhaktamauliratha so’pi ca lakṣalakṣaṃ
varṣāṇi harṣulamanā bhuvaneṣu kāmam |
saṅgāpayan guṇagaṇaṃ tava sundarībhiḥ
saṅgātirekarahito lalitaṃ cacāra || 23-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अत्यन्तसङ्गविलयाय भवत्प्रणुन्नो
नूनं स रौप्यगिरिमाप्य महत्समाजे ।
निश्शङ्कमङ्ककृतवल्लभमङ्गजारिं
तं शङ्करं परिहसन्नुमयाऽभिशेपे ॥ २३-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Chitraketu saw Lord Shiva seated in assembly of sages and Goddess Uma seated on his lap. He mocked at Goddess Uma, who in turn cursed him to be born as asura.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
atyantasaṅgavilayāya bhavatpraṇunno
nūnaṃ sa raupyagirimāpya mahatsamāje |
niśśaṅkamaṅkakṛtavallabhamaṅgajāriṃ
taṃ śaṅkaraṃ parihasannumayā’bhiśepe || 23-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
निस्सम्भ्रमस्त्वयमयाचितशापमोक्षो
वृत्रासुरत्वमुपगम्य सुरेन्द्रयोधी ।
भक्त्याऽऽत्मतत्त्वकथनैः समरे विचित्रं
शत्रोरपि भ्रममपास्य गतः पदं ते ॥ २३-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Chitraketu was born as Vritthasura and even though he was an asura and fought with Indra, he imparted the knowledge about Lord to him and removed delusion of his enemy too and so was blessed to reach Vaikunta. What a wonder!
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nissambhramastvayamayācitaśāpamokṣo
vṛtrāsuratvamupagamya surendrayodhī |
bhaktyā”tmatattvakathanaiḥ samare vicitraṃ
śatrorapi bhramamapāsya gataḥ padaṃ te || 23-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वत्सेवनेन दितिरिन्द्रवधोद्यताऽपि
तान् प्रत्युतेन्द्रसुहृदो मरुतोऽभिलेभे ।
दुष्टाशयोऽपि शुभदैव भवन्निषेवा
तत्तादृशस्त्वमव मां पवनालयेश ॥ २३-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Diti, the mother of the Asuras, worshipped Bhagwan in order to have a son who would kill Indra, but instead gave birth to Maruts who became friends of Indra. By worshipping Bhagwan, even an evil minded person receives good only.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvatsevanena ditirindravadhodyatā’pi
tān pratyutendrasuhṛdo maruto’bhilebhe |
duṣṭāśayo’pi śubhadaiva bhavanniṣevā
tattādṛśastvamava māṃ pavanālayeśa || 23-11 ||
